name: dsc-provider-switch
description: dsc 插件 dsc-provider-switch:内置 DeepSeek(Anthropic 形态)与 OpenAI、Anthropic 兼容预设供应端点,激活时经 context.provider.registerSource 注册,并提供文本生成与模型列表两条 context.provider.run 封装;另经 settings:surface 登记设置表面,端点启停、API Key 与自定义 baseUrl 在宿主设置页填写
author: omds-chat

description.zh-CN: 供应端点切换的 dsc 插件:内置 DeepSeek(Anthropic 形态)与 OpenAI、Anthropic 兼容预设端点,激活时注册给宿主,插件侧提供文本生成与模型列表的调用封装;设置表面经 settings:surface 登记,端点启停、密钥填写与自定义 baseUrl 在宿主设置页完成
description.en-US: A dsc plugin for switching provider endpoints: ships built-in DeepSeek (Anthropic-compatible) plus OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible preset endpoints, registers them with the host on activation, and wraps context.provider.run for text generation and model listing; its settings surface is declared via settings:surface, so endpoint toggles, API keys and custom base URLs are filled in on the host settings page
